# Build a Continuous Software Engine

> A conceptual guide to building a deterministic engine around coding agents so your repository makes continuous, verified progress without babysitting.

Stop trying to make an AI finish a giant task in one great prompt. Wrap fresh coding agent sessions inside a deterministic orchestrator that owns durable state, independent verification, crash and livelock recovery, non-blocking human steering, and Git-native multiplayer coordination.

## Core Ethos

- The deterministic orchestrator owns the loop: ordinary software controls state transitions, leases, timeouts, retries, and landing.
- Design for failure first: expect hung processes, dropped networks, model oscillation, and merge conflicts.
- Non-blocking over blocking: waiting for human approval or network recovery must never freeze unrelated ready work or hold worker slots.
- Favor focus over features: small, single-purpose goals land cleanly, isolate blame, and stay easy to review.
- Git and files over chat history: treat context windows as disposable RAM and store intent, contracts, and landed outcomes in Git.
- Approachable, human-readable evidence: save raw command output, diffs, review verdicts, and rollback reasons as plain files.

## Chapters

- [Overview & Ethos](https://thisistheway.to/engine): From prompting to engine architecture, the six core ethos rules, high-level loop diagram, and map of the five primitives
- [1. State & Contracts Outside the Context Window](https://thisistheway.to/engine/state-and-contracts): Content-hashed Markdown goal contracts, isolated disposable Git worktrees, commit trailers as recovery source of truth, raw evidence directories, and a local transactional ledger with leases and monotonic fencing tokens
- [2. Independent Verification & Transactional Landing](https://thisistheway.to/engine/verification-and-landing): Separating builders from judges with deterministic gates, fresh-context independent review, rebase-then-verify pre-landing health checks, and automatic culprit-only rollback that spares innocent commits and never reverts human commits
- [3. Never Getting Stuck: Watchdogs, Recovery & Liveness](https://thisistheway.to/engine/liveness-and-recovery): Detached process-group watchdogs with owner-death signaling, livelock detection, network-drop parking without burning retries, strategy rotation, oscillation and file-reversal guards, and unifying scheduler readiness into one pure decision model with exhaustive finite-state liveness tests
- [4. Ambition, Self-Improvement & Human Steering](https://thisistheway.to/engine/ambition-and-steering): Non-blocking human approval parking with accumulated feedback, an ambition document paired with a read-only planner, self-improvement goals spawned from recurring cross-task failure signatures, and metric-gated experiments that land only when the measured number improves
- [5. Multiplayer & Multi-Machine Coordination](https://thisistheway.to/engine/multiplayer-coordination): Turning rough GitHub issues into researched single-goal PRs that activate on merge, bidirectional sync via in-memory 3-way merge pull and verified fast-forward-only push, atomic remote Git ref leases with TTL, heartbeat, and clock-skew margin, and landing-time trailer deduplication
